caseHighlight.body: Visibility over the numbers, subcontractors and the daily rhythm, without adding turnover.

caseStudy.intro: The following is an excerpt from an analysis Virkum delivered for an Icelandic contractor with approximately ISK 1.6bn turnover and 37 FTEs.
caseStudy.summary: Most likely scenario, without additional turnover or headcount growth. Virkum's analysis showed realistic earnings improvement of ISK 25–80m per year through formal subcontractor governance, clearer structure and targeted automation.
caseStudy.strengthsBody: Profitable operations, strong equity position (50.1%), stable gross margin (66.6%) and improved efficiency per FTE. Revenue per FTE rose from ISK 33.7m to ISK 42.5m, a 26% increase over two years.
caseStudy.risksBody: Growing reliance on subcontractors (purchased services up 54% year-on-year), unclear processes for managing purchased services, and increasing need for formal management routines alongside a planned corporate split.
caseStudy.scenariosTitle: Three scenarios for the next 12 months
caseStudy.scenariosIntro: Same turnover, different earnings depending on how well improvements land. Assumptions are based on how much time converts into improved earnings.
caseStudy.closingBody: The company is well run and profitable. The analysis is therefore not about correcting poor management, but about opportunities to lock in current performance and prepare the company for the next operational phase, without increasing turnover or headcount.

recommendations.title: Formal process for subcontractor governance
recommendations.body: Purchased services grew 54% in one year and now represent 16% of operating revenue. Without a formal process for selection, pricing and follow-up, margin erodes on every project.

recommendations.title: Digital time tracking and standardised quoting
recommendations.body: A mobile time-tracking solution and standard pricing based on real data saves ~10 hours/week combined for project managers and sales, and improves quote accuracy.

recommendations.title: Real-time management dashboard
recommendations.body: Automated dashboard for revenue, project profit, receivables status and staff utilisation. Replaces manual monthly reports and improves shareholder decision-making.

recommendations.title: Structured customer database (CRM)
recommendations.body: Existing customers are the most valuable sales channel, retention and renewals cost a fraction of new sales. Without systematic follow-up, that opportunity is left unused.

grantsSection.title: Reduce cost by up to 90%
grantsSection.body: Workforce development funds can reimburse up to 90% of consulting and training costs. We handle the applications.

low.title: Your operations are on a strong path.
low.body: You already have many fundamentals in place: dashboards, clear ownership, and automation in daily workflows. Virkum may not be urgent right now.

mid.title: The foundation is solid, but there are gaps.
mid.body: Operations work, but several areas are weaker than they should be. A focused operational review will identify what to improve over the next 6-12 months.

high.title: You have a lot to gain from action.
high.body: Based on your answers, operations depend too heavily on you, manual work consumes time, and decision data is not available when needed. This is exactly what Virkum helps fix.

gervigreindPage.metaTitle: AI policy and daily use in companies | Virkum
gervigreindPage.metaDescription: How Virkum uses AI in daily operations, the limits we keep around client data, and how Icelandic companies can write a policy of their own.
gervigreindPage.intro: Virkum uses AI deliberately in daily work, as a tool, not a magic solution. This is our stance on how we use it and how we support clients.
gervigreindPage.ctaTitle: Want to discuss AI in your operations?
gervigreindPage.ctaBody: Book a free 60-minute call where we review where AI can deliver most value for your company, and where it should not be used.

sections.title: Ground rules
sections.body: AI speeds work; it does not replace judgment. Everything we deliver to clients goes through human review. Responsibility always sits with the person who signs off.

sections.title: Client data
sections.body: We never send confidential client data into public AI systems without consent. For sensitive work we use paid tiers with enterprise terms that prohibit training on your data. Personally identifiable information is scrubbed before it enters any system.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: We use AI in preparation, analysis, drafting and research. That makes work faster and deeper, you get better output in less time, not cheaper work at lower quality.

sections.title: What we do not do
sections.body: We do not forward unchecked AI output directly to clients. We do not let AI make decisions about people, hiring, termination or performance reviews. We do not sell “AI” as a product on its own.

sections.title: Our clients
sections.body:
A recent Statistics Iceland survey shows that 50% of Icelandic firms use AI but only 14% have a formal usage policy. That gap, AI in daily use without clear guardrails, is one of today’s biggest operational risks.

We help clients bridge it: define policy, scope use cases, and embed it in how the company operates, not as a one-off project, but as part of normal maturity.

personuverndPage.metaDescription: What Virkum stores from contact and booking, when Google Analytics loads, and how cookies and your language choice stay in the browser.
personuverndPage.title: Privacy policy
personuverndPage.intro: Virkum ehf. emphasizes protecting personal data for visitors of virkum.is and users of our services. This policy describes what data we collect, why we collect it and how you can exercise your rights.
personuverndPage.pcollect: We collect information you provide directly, for example name, email, phone number and company name, when you contact us or book through our scheduling link. When you book via Calendly, information you submit is processed by Calendly as an independent service under Calendly's privacy policy and terms.
personuverndPage.puse: Data is used only to respond to inquiries, deliver requested services and send requested materials. We never sell data to third parties.
personuverndPage.pcookies: We use Google Analytics 4 (Google) to understand how virkum.is is used. The GA4 script and related cookies are loaded only if you choose Accept in our cookie banner; if you choose Reject or do not accept, they are not loaded.
personuverndPage.pcookiesDetail: GA4 processes technical and usage data (such as page views, approximate location derived from IP, device and browser information and identifiers stored in cookies) to produce aggregated statistics. We do not use this GA4 integration for personalised advertising. Your analytics consent choice (accept or reject) and your selected site language are stored in your browser's local storage so we do not need to ask again on every visit. Ordinary outbound links may take you to third-party sites (for example Calendly when booking); those services apply their own privacy notices once you leave virkum.is.

namskeidPage.intro: All courses are designed for owners and managers who want stronger operations. Eligible training costs can be reimbursed through workforce development funds.
namskeidPage.automationTitle: Automation and training, two parts of one programme.
namskeidPage.automationBody: When Virkum implements systems, dashboards or automation, the project has two parts: implementation and training. Implementation, setup, integration and advisory, is the company’s investment. Training, teaching staff the new systems, is often eligible for reimbursement.
namskeidPage.implBody: Systems setup, automation, dashboards and data flows. Paid by the company.
namskeidPage.trainBody: Hands-on training on new systems and workflows. Up to 90% reimbursed.
namskeidPage.automationFootnote: That means total project cost can fall by roughly 25–35% when the training portion is reimbursed.
namskeidPage.reimbBody: Workforce funds reimburse corporate training costs. We help identify the right fund and support the application.
namskeidPage.howBody: Companies paying into training funds can apply for reimbursement after delivery by submitting invoice, payment receipt and participant list. We help clients complete the process at no extra cost.
namskeidPage.moreBody: Book a 60-minute walkthrough to identify which courses fit your company and estimate reimbursement.

courses.title: Operational analysis and action plan
courses.description: Structured analysis of your company’s operations, people, processes, systems and numbers. The outcome is a clear action plan with 3–5 priority initiatives with the greatest impact on performance over the next 6–12 months. Participants receive both the analysis and training in using the data for decisions.
courses.markhopur: Owners, managing directors and leadership teams in companies with 10–100 employees.
courses.innihald: Financial analysis, process mapping, team assessment, interviews with key people, action plan and presentation.

courses.title: Goal setting and dashboards
courses.description: A workshop where the leadership team sets measurable 90-day goals, defines key performance indicators (KPIs) and builds a dashboard that shows operational status in real time. Participants learn to steer with numbers instead of gut feeling.
courses.markhopur: Leadership teams (3–8 people). Owners and everyone accountable for operational results.
courses.innihald: 90-day goal setting, KPI selection and definition, dashboard setup, weekly follow-up for 4 weeks.

courses.title: Meeting rhythm and accountability
courses.description: Training to establish a working weekly meeting rhythm that keeps the team accountable, resolves issues quickly and keeps everyone aligned. Includes one workshop day and 8 weeks of coaching where we join your meetings and teach the right cadence.
courses.markhopur: Leadership teams that spend too much time in low-value meetings, or lack a consistent meeting structure.
courses.innihald: Meeting agenda, issue identification and problem solving, ownership handoffs, follow-up system, and leadership training in meeting facilitation.

courses.title: Strategy and future vision
courses.description: A two-day workshop where the leadership team defines core values, strategic focus, a 3-year picture and a 1-year plan. The result is a single document everyone in the company can read and understand, strategy on one page. Participants learn a methodology you can repeat every quarter.
courses.markhopur: Owners and leadership teams who want to align people, processes and goals under one clear strategy.
courses.innihald: Core values, strategic focus, 10-year target, 3-year picture, 1-year plan, 90-day priorities, and future vision on one page.

courses.title: AI and automation in daily operations
courses.description: A practical workshop where leaders and staff learn to use AI and automation to save time on everyday tasks. No deep technical background required, we start from real tasks in your operations and show how technology solves them.
courses.markhopur: Everyone in the company, from owner to frontline staff. Especially teams spending time on manual, repetitive work.
courses.innihald: AI tools for office work, automated reporting, communication automation, process analysis and automation opportunities.

courses.title: Team coaching and accountability systems
courses.description: Training to build a clear accountability system where every seat has an owner, every role is defined and the right people are in the right seats. Participants learn to assess the team systematically and make difficult people decisions on a professional basis.
courses.markhopur: Owners and leaders who feel something is off in the team but cannot pinpoint what.
courses.innihald: Accountability chart, role definitions, team assessment, hiring framework, and quarterly reviews.

courses.title: Training on new systems and automation
courses.description: When a new system or automation is rolled out, people need practical training. This programme is tailored to each company based on the tools and workflows implemented, dashboards, project tools, automated communications or data flows. Training on-site or remote.
courses.markhopur: Staff and leaders who received new implementations and need hands-on training, not just a demo, until the system is part of daily work.
courses.innihald: System walkthroughs, exercises on real tasks, troubleshooting, automation workflow documentation, and follow-up modules to ensure adoption.
